text:
maria: Heads-up: replay harness showing increased mismatch after kernel selector changes on staging. Need quick audit.

 tanner: saw that. mismatch ~3.7% on same trace slice (slice id 2026-03-17-19). correlated with kv-cache warmup + kernel fallback.

 devin: can you paste the exact flags/config used for the run?

 maria: sure, here's the command we used:
```
./tools/replay --trace /traces/2026-03-17.slice --seed 42 --sample-rate 0.05 \n  --kernel-policy auto-crosswalk --kv-warmup true --batching heuristic-v2
```

 maria: and sampling config:
```json
{"sampler":{"type":"stratified","cohorts":["short","medium","long"],"ratio":0.05}}
```

 samir: quick hypothesis: kernel crosswalk changed kernel selection ordering so some requests hit a quantized kernel that behaves slightly differently when kv-cache is cold. That would explain time-dependent mismatches.

 tanner: agree. i instrumented token-level diffs. most mismatches are in first 16 tokens after prompt. suggests kv-cache warmup.

 devin: let's run parity with kv-cache zeroed and with forced cache-warm paths to compare. also run per-kernel crosswalk: force each kernel variant and compare outputs.

 replay-bot: parity-run started: https://redwood-internal/replays/19576 (logs stream)

 replay-bot: parity results: overall mismatch 3.72%. by kernel: gpu-fp16: 0.8%, gpu-int8: 4.9%, cpu-quant: 6.1%. kv-warmup zeroed run mismatch drops to 0.9%.

 maria: wow. that's a clear signal. kernel selection + kv warmup interaction.

 samir: for determinism checks we should pin RNG, disable async prefetch, and also run 1000 short traces to get a stable stat. I'll add a small harness script.

 samir: script snippet:
```
for k in gpu-fp16 gpu-int8 cpu-quant; do
  ./tools/replay --force-kernel $k --seed 0 --trials 1000 --kv-warmup false \n    --out results/${k}.json
done
```

 tanner: also add an apples-to-apples test where we run old kernel-selector (baseline) vs new and compare token-level edit distance, latency, and mem.

 devin: agreed. propose new test card in perf-suite:
- baseline selector v2026-02-01
- candidate selector v2026-03-10
- sample cohort: 5k traces stratified by length
- metrics: mismatch %, token-edit-dist, p99 latency, peak mem

 maria: putting this into a GH issue and tagging owners. I'll create canary run later today. :thumbsup: 

 tanner: @maria please include the per-kernel logs and the kv-warmup toggle in the issue. i'll help with the perf dashboards.

 maria: thanks all. action items: (1) samir -> harness script + deterministic runs (due EOD), (2) devin -> add apples-to-apples card + config (tomorrow), (3) tanner -> dashboards and alert thresholds. I'll orbit the rollout policy.

 maria: closing the loop here. will post results as soon as parity runs finish. (reaction :eyes: by tanner)
